source_text: Cultural relativism, as applied to female genital mutilation (FGM), maintains that the practice cannot be fairly evaluated through external moral frameworks, such as those predominant in Western societies, but must instead be understood through the lens of the specific cultural norms and values of communities where it occurs. [31]
